question: how many q drops do i get
answer: Undergraduates normally get four Q-drops at Texas A&M. State law also caps dropped courses at six across all Texas public schools.

history.content: how many q drops do i get
Undergraduates normally get four Q-drops at Texas A&M (https://student-rules.tamu.edu/rule01/).

question: do one hour classes count toward that
answer: No. Q-drops in one-hour courses don't count toward the four, but they do count toward the state limit of six dropped courses.

question: what if i drop the lab with it
answer: Dropping a lecture and its companion lab at the same time counts as one Q-drop, not two.

question: i got an incomplete in a class, when do i have to finish the work
answer: Before the last day of scheduled classes of the next long semester you enroll in, unless your dean, with the instructor's consent, grants an extension.

history.content: i got an incomplete in a class, when do i have to finish the work
Before the last day of scheduled classes of the next long semester you enroll in, unless your dean, with the instructor's consent, gives you more time (https://student-rules.tamu.edu/rule10/).

question: and if i don't
